content.text: {"conditions":{"rc1":{"status":"gap","note":"The FAD's conclusion that Complainant 'failed to prove' discrimination is stated without any cited evidence or reasoning linking the ROI contents to that conclusion, so it cannot be reconstructed from the record."},"rc2":{"status":"review","note":"Only one characterization is tied to a source (RMOs' awareness of race 'from observation,' ROI at 101), while the incident allegations in 1(a)-(e) and the termination rationale are given without identified witness or document attribution."},"rc3":{"status":"gap","note":"The chronology is internally inconsistent and incomplete: termination is dated September 18, 2020 yet the separation email is dated September 24 and cites no-call/no-shows since September 18, item 1(c) and 1(e) have unspecified dates, and no prior interventions or review period are identified."},"rc4":{"status":"gap","note":"The record names RMOs but does not document who decided the termination, what criteria (e.g., job abandonment threshold) applied, or whether Complainant's explanation was considered, and the FAD author's analysis is not described."},"rc5":{"status":"gap","note":"Because reconstructability, chronology, and decision-process traceability are not met and sourcing is thin, an independent reviewer could not assess from this record whether the FAD's no-discrimination conclusion is supported."}}}
